description: Takes an approved prototype version into the project. An .html target gets the page copied through a checkpoint (overwrite=true to replace an existing file) and is audited there. Any other target (a slice or directory of a React, Flutter… app) returns the design tokens, the markup and the steps to port it into components.

agent.description: The agent role making this call (e.g. "dev", "qa", "e2e"), so its work is attributed to it. Defaults to HEXACORE_AGENT.

target.description: docs/index.html, public/landing.html… or a slice directory such as src/features/landing

name: promote_prototype
title: Promote a prototype into the project
